subject: science
concept: Understanding energy flow through ecosystems: trophic levels and energy pyramids
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Cycles of Matter and Energy Transfer) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student stacks physical blocks representing energy amounts at each trophic level, seeing the pyramid narrow
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an organism to its correct trophic level in an energy pyramid
exercise.abstract: Student explains why energy decreases at each successive trophic level

misconception_flags: believes energy is passed on completely unchanged between trophic levels rather than mostly lost as heat

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
